title: Migrate Radical Representational Succession
summary: Migrated the generated fractional-exponent-to-radical animation to a compiled representational-succession plan. The base x reflows independently before notation act; exponent numerator, line, and denominator retain individual DOM/token identity and nonzero scale while following measured opposite-corner paths; radical tokens unfold from the shared seed with measured far-side stagger; one shared focus shadow spans the source notation; and exact source/target native endpoints settle before release. The dashboard fold/bundle/swap exemplar remains the renderer comparison adapter rather than semantic authority.

sourceRefs.summary: Approved slice intent, risk, verification, commit boundary, and stop condition.
Accepted normative choreography and gestalt-style design.
Compiles continuant and representational lineage, lifecycle, salience, hierarchy, focus, path requirement, propagation rule, and phase timeline for radical succession.
Samples independent exponent tokens through a geometry-derived opposite corner and unfolds target tokens with far-side stagger and nonzero per-token scale.
Carries representational-succession mode and precomputed relation paths in measured geometry.
Attaches selected measured relation paths so the persistent base can use restrained collision-aware reflow.
Uses the successor sampler for notation, isolates base reflow, preserves path evidence, and composes native focus transforms.
Samples the radical envelope, binds shared group focus, exposes hierarchy/path/propagation evidence, and removes the shared shadow on release.
Adds one absolute nonsemantic shared shadow field without participating in equation layout.
Proves compiled lineage, hierarchy authority, phase isolation, opposite-corner token motion, far-side stagger, nonzero token scale, and exact settlement.
Proves visible orient/reflow/act/release, persistent stage identity, independent exponent tokens, no whole-layer scaling, opposite-corner paths, and native endpoint cleanup.
Updates the radical dashboard comparison to the observed generated shared plan while retaining the legacy adapter distinction.
